components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The safe affirmative action for one local decision or release step.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 700 12px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease), border-color 180ms var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #c9e595; border-color: #c9e595; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Candidate Row
components.description: The only candidate admitted by Selector topN=1.
components.css: .ds-candidate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px minmax(160px,1fr) 70px 100px; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 62px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: #14190f; color: var(--text); text-align: left; box-shadow: inset 3px 0 var(--accent); transition: background-color 180ms var(--ease); cursor: pointer; } .ds-candidate:hover { background: var(--surface-active); } .ds-candidate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-rank,.ds-score { color: var(--accent); font: 700 13px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-score,.ds-state { text-align: right; } .ds-symbol { display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-symbol strong { font-size:15px; } .ds-symbol small { color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; } .ds-state { color:var(--accent); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Capability Node
components.description: One ordered stage in the six-stage Atlas Agent chain.
components.css: .ds-capability { display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr); gap:12px; min-height:160px; padding:20px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); text-align:left; transition:background-color 180ms var(--ease); cursor:pointer; } .ds-capability:hover { background:var(--surface-active); } .ds-capability:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-step,.ds-meta { color:var(--muted); font:400 12px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-capability-body { display:flex; min-width:0; flex-direction:column; } .ds-capability-top { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; } .ds-capability-top strong { font-size:16px; } .ds-capability-top em { color:var(--positive); font-size:12px; font-style:normal; font-weight:700; } .ds-output { margin-top:13px; color:var(--text-soft); font-size:14px; line-height:1.55; } .ds-artifacts { margin-top:9px; color:var(--warning); font-size:11px; } .ds-meta { margin-top:auto; padding-top:12px; }

components.name: Selection Statistics
components.description: The aperture summary that makes broad input and single output explicit.
components.css: .ds-stats { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(90px,1fr) 32px minmax(90px,1fr) 32px minmax(90px,1fr); align-items:center; max-width:620px; padding:24px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); } .ds-stats div { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:10px; } .ds-stats strong { font:700 30px/1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-stats span,.ds-stats b { color:var(--muted); font-size:13px; } .ds-stats b { text-align:center; font-weight:400; } .ds-stats .ds-final strong,.ds-stats .ds-final span { color:var(--accent); }

components.name: Structured Input
components.description: A readable bilingual field for thesis and candidate proposal drafts.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:7px; color:var(--text-soft); font:700 12px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field input { min-height:44px; padding:10px 12px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font:400 16px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-field input[readonly] { color:var(--accent); font-family:var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Release Rail
components.description: The auditable Candidate state machine from Draft through Paper.
components.css: .ds-release { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); } .ds-release div { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 8px; border-right:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--muted); } .ds-release div:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-release span { display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); font:700 12px/1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-release strong { font-size:11px; } .ds-release .is-done { color:var(--positive); } .ds-release .is-current { color:var(--accent); } .ds-release .is-current span { border-color:var(--accent); background:#151a10; }

components.name: Controlled Copilot Drawer
components.description: A bounded read, explain, and draft surface with no execution authority.
components.html:
CONTROLLED ASSISTANT

Query evidence or prepare a Candidate draft. The running profile and exchange write path remain protected.
components.css: .ds-drawer { width:min(390px,100vw); min-height:360px; border-left:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:0; background:var(--surface); color:var(--text); box-shadow:-18px 0 48px rgb(0 0 0 / .28); } .ds-drawer header { display:flex; min-height:78px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--surface-raised); } .ds-drawer header span { color:var(--muted); font:700 12px/1.4 var(--font-mono); } .ds-drawer h2 { margin:4px 0 0; font-size:21px; } .ds-drawer button { min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-soft); cursor:pointer; } .ds-drawer button:hover { background:var(--surface-active); } .ds-drawer button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-drawer-body { padding:24px 20px; } .ds-drawer-body strong { color:var(--accent); font-size:13px; } .ds-drawer-body p { margin-top:12px; color:var(--text-soft); font-size:15px; line-height:1.6; }

narrative.overview:
TradeBoard is the operating surface for one Atlas Trading Agent. A broad market universe enters through a visible aperture, but `Selector topN=1` admits exactly one auditable symbol into the cycle. The interface gives that selection, the running Agent, its six-stage chain, current position, and one required human action clear priority.

The world is cold graphite, hard seams, system sans, mono evidence, and a single chartreuse live signal. It is bilingual by construction and restrained in density. Bull/Bear and Position Monitor remain inspectable artifacts inside the main chain rather than peer stages that inflate the topology. Agent Lab owns candidate evolution; Audit Log owns historical trace; Copilot stays a controlled drawer.
keyCharacteristics: One running Atlas Trading Agent and one admitted symbol per cycle.
Selection narrows 42 scanned candidates to 8 qualified and 1 admitted.
Six visible stages: Selector, Data, Analysis, Decision, Risk, and Execution.
Bull/Bear artifacts nest under Analysis; Position Monitor nests under Decision.
Candidate release requires Draft, Backtest, Walk-Forward, human Approval, then Paper.
Chinese and English share one layout and evidence hierarchy.
Mock data and the missing Runtime API are always explicit.

rules.name: The One Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse identifies the single admitted path and its safe action. Never spread it across unrelated decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Isolation Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, coral, and blue keep their operational meanings.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Use sans for interpretation and mono for facts that must be compared or audited.

rules.name: The Aperture Before Chain Rule
rules.body: Show universe narrowing before downstream reasoning so users understand why the only symbol entered the cycle.

rules.name: The One-Agent Rule
rules.body: Fixed coin tabs and multiple equal-weight Trading Agents are prohibited; candidates are inputs, not separate Agent identities.

rules.name: The Flat Runtime Rule
rules.body: Persistent operating modules never float; only overlays and transient feedback use cast shadow.

rules.name: The Hard Seam Rule
rules.body: A new component starts rectangular and attached. Round only a state dot.

dos: Do make Atlas, its one admitted symbol, and `topN=1` immediately clear.
Do preserve the six-stage chain and nest Bull/Bear and Position Monitor artifacts.
Do keep candidate approval and Paper release as distinct, auditable states.
Do maintain complete Chinese and English labels without changing hierarchy.
Do expose the synthetic-data banner and disconnected exchange-write boundary.
Do preserve keyboard focus, focus return, reduced motion, and responsive stacking.
donts: Don't introduce fixed BTC/ETH/SOL tabs or multiple equal-weight running Agents.
Don't flatten Bull, Bear, or Position Monitor into extra primary stages.
Don't imply that candidate inspection, Copilot, or a draft can execute.
Don't hide the mock/runtime boundary or invent live API connectivity.
Don't add rounded SaaS cards, ambient chartreuse, decorative glow, or high-amplitude motion.
